name: Brother Kristoff
summary: In Stormwind's Cathedral Square, Brother Kristoff preaches beneath Uther's statue. A human priest of the Church of the Holy Light, he stands outdoors near the great statue of Uther the Lightbringer and seeks practical books for sermons on spiritual strength.

sections.title: A Preacher by the Statue
sections.body: Brother Kristoff serves the Church of the Holy Light in Cathedral Square, beneath the statue of Uther the Lightbringer. He works among the citizens and pilgrims who pass through the plaza, rather than remaining within the Cathedral of Light. For sermons such as the Fortitude of the Spirit, he turns to worldly comparisons. In The Stresses of Iron, he finds a way to explain how the mortal soul endures pressure, comparing the Holy Light's gift of inner resolve to the tempered strength of worked metal.

faq.answer: Brother Kristoff is a human priest and scholar of the Church of the Holy Light. He works outdoors in Stormwind's Cathedral Square, near the great statue of Uther the Lightbringer.

faq.q: What does Brother Kristoff do in Cathedral Square?
aliases: why is brother kristoff standing outside
faq.answer: Brother Kristoff prepares sermons on the Light and faith. He is working on a sermon about the Fortitude of the Spirit and seeks references in books about metallurgy to explain spiritual resilience.

faq.q: Why does Brother Kristoff need a book about iron?
faq.answer: Brother Kristoff seeks The Stresses of Iron for his sermon on fortitude. He uses iron under stress as an earthly comparison for how devotion to the Holy Light strengthens the mortal spirit against adversity.

angles.text: As a priest, you may value Brother Kristoff's grounded approach to the liturgy. He draws on practical arts to teach the deeper mysteries of inner fortitude.
As a blacksmith, you may find it amusing that a cleric of the Light turns to books about iron stress and metallurgy to teach the clergy about resilience.
